title: Budget store (budget-store@1)
description: customers/<tenant>/budgets.json — the per-agent throttle. A missing kind is unbudgeted, not zero; -1 is unlimited and must be written on purpose.

tenant.description: must equal the directory it sits in

period.description: the window Paperclip throttles over; the report always reconciles the calendar month

budget.description: keyed by metering kind (jobs, documents, storage, and any kind added later); a missing kind is unbudgeted — the report says so instead of assuming zero

enforced.description: false records an advisory budget: the report may still find an overrun, but the throttle never stopped it
